description:
The 2026-05 S3 (cross-CPU) and S5 (GPU crossover) benchmark receipts under the gf2-algebra permanent campaign lack immutable measurement-source provenance (no committed harness SHA identifying the executable state), so they cannot serve as authoritative evidence under current standards.

## Background

An external research-methodology review of the 2026-08-07 feasibility study flagged the historical receipts as pre-existing debt: they corroborate newer measurements but their provenance cannot be reconstructed. The feasibility study already treats them as corroboration-only; the durable record should say so where the receipts live.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The provenance record accompanying the S3/S5 receipt CSVs states that the receipts lack immutable measurement-source provenance and are corroboration-only, citing the 2026-08-07 review finding.
- [hard] REQ-02: Any in-tree prose citing S3/S5 numbers as authoritative evidence is swept and requalified in the same change.
title: Mark historical S3/S5 permanent-benchmark receipts as non-authoritative
